task: T5: make a run addressable, in scripts/ralph-log.sh log_init. After LOG_DIR is resolved and created, maintain a symlink named `latest` in LOG_DIR's PARENT directory pointing at LOG_DIR's basename — a RELATIVE target, because an absolute one breaks the moment the repo is cloned or the container that wrote it is gone. Replace any existing `latest` atomically (`ln -sfn`), and never fail the loop if the filesystem has no symlink support. LOG_DIR's own basename stays exactly `<agent>-<pid>` — do not fold a label, slug or timestamp into it, because every reader parses the pid out of that leaf. Also read the optional `RUN_LABEL` environment variable and expose it for T4's record, defaulting to null (a JSON null, not the empty string) when unset.
